name: Auto Shops
title: Referral Partners for Auto Shops | Our Local Network
description: We visit the car washes, parts stores and dealerships near your auto shop in Lombard, Elmhurst and Oak Brook. You see every sign-up in your portal.
cardBlurb: We visit the car washes, parts stores and dealerships drivers stop at.
intro: We find businesses near your shop that drivers already stop at. Every month we visit them and introduce your shop by name.
partnersIntro: Drivers stop here often, and they ask the staff when their car acts up.

partners.name: Car washes
partners.why: Drivers who care for their cars come often, and the crew sees what shape they're in.

partners.name: Car dealerships
partners.why: Buyers of used cars past warranty need a shop they trust close to home.

partners.name: Auto parts stores
partners.why: Do-it-yourselfers sometimes find out the job is bigger than the driveway.

partners.name: Gas stations
partners.why: Drivers ask the counter staff where to go when a warning light comes on.

partners.name: Towing companies
partners.why: Every tow ends with the same question: where should the car go?

partners.name: Driving schools
partners.why: New drivers and their parents need a shop they trust for a first car.

treatsIntro: We bring coffee and treats for everyone on shift, from the counter to the crew out back.
treatExamples: Coffee and donuts for a parts counter's morning crew
Snacks and coffee for a car wash crew before the Saturday rush
Muffins and coffee for a towing company's early dispatchers
portalNote: Each sign-up lands in your portal, ready for your service desk to call and book.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: You and each partner agree to promote each other. Nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: No competing bays
notes.text: We never visit other repair shops for you.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We describe your shop only in words you approve.

exclusivity: Partners agree to promote one auto shop like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: I already call a tow company. Will you visit them?
faq.a: Not unless you ask. We skip businesses you already work with, and those relationships stay yours.

faq.q: Dealerships have their own service departments. Why visit one?
faq.a: Only if it shares your customers without competing, and only if you approve it. If you'd rather skip dealerships, we leave them off.

faq.q: Do I need to come along on the visits?
faq.a: No. Our field team makes every visit, and you see each stop in your portal.

aboutText: I'm asking about referral partners for my auto shop.
